name: number-field
title: Number Field
description: Locale-aware numeric input on Base UI's NumberField in upstream's InputGroup chrome, with full-height flanking steppers.

meta.whenToUse: Any numeric value — quantities, limits, percentages, money (format={{ style: 'currency', currency }}) — where parsing, locale formatting, and stepping should be correct by construction.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-text that merely contains digits (phone numbers, postal codes, ids) — formatting/stepping semantics would fight the value; use Input.
